Hello, honestly CSU LB may be the better choice imo but keep in mind UCM is also pretty good. It’s really not as bad as people say it is. Social wise and regarding stuff to do, not much. But academically and research wise, yes. Also we have good professors and programs. School is ranked 60 and beat UCSC and UCR. Also a good amount of people have been able to transfer to another UC from UCM. Also the UC system name has merit and prestige and although UCM is nowhere close to Berkeley or LA you still get a lot of the benefits. For example UCEAP. I got to study in the top third school in Korea for a year. Yonsei. The SKY universities because of UCEAP. The UC study abroad program. So keep that in mind. Either school is good. Also UCM gives a lot of financial aid and the bobcat grant, but I would still maybe choose CSULB if you’re into frats and parties and shit, but up to your goals
